331: ਕਉਨੁ ਕੋ ਪੂਤੁ; ਪਿਤਾ ਕੋ ਕਾ ਕੋ ॥
Whose son is anyone? Whose father is anyone?
Who dies, and who causes grief by dying? ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਠਗ; ਜਗ ਕਉ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
The Lord, the deceiver, has dosed the world with the stupefying herb of attachment,
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਬਿਓਗ; ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਅਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but I, O my mother, cannot live apart from the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਉਨ ਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਕਉਨ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Whose husband is anyone? Whose wife is anyone?
Grasp this reality while you are in this human body. ॥2॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਠਗ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Says Kabir: one whose mind has become one with the deceiver
is free of the herb, for he has come to know the deceiver. ॥3॥39॥
ਅਬ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
The Lord, the King who gives light everywhere, has now become my helper;
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਟਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
cutting the bond of birth and death, I have reached the highest spiritual state. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He has joined me to the company of the holy,
and rescued me from the five enemies.
With my tongue I now repeat His Name, which gives undying life.
He has made me His own servant without any price. ॥1॥
The true Guru has shown me great kindness,
he has drawn me out of the ocean of the world.
Love for the Lord's beautiful feet has taken hold in me.
The Lord dwells in my heart at every moment. ॥2॥
The burning of Maya has gone; its blazing fire is put out.
There is contentment in my mind; the Name has become its support.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
In water and on land, everywhere, the Lord my Master is present;
wherever I look, there is He who knows every heart. ॥3॥
He Himself has made His devotion firm within me.
What was written for me from past lives has come to me, my brother.
ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਾਜ ॥
For the one on whom He has mercy, He brings about this good fortune.
Kabir's Master is the one who cherishes the poor. ॥4॥40॥
ਜਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਥਲਿ ਹੈ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
There is pollution in water and pollution on land; pollution arises everywhere.
ਜਨਮੇ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਮੂਏ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕ ਪਰਜ ਬਿਗੋਈ ॥੧॥
There is pollution at a birth and again at a death; the world is being ruined by this notion of pollution. ॥1॥
Tell me, pandit, who then can be pure?
ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Think this through carefully, my friend, and tell me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਬੈਨਹੁ ਸੂਤਕੁ; ਸੂਤਕੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
There is pollution in the eyes, pollution in speech, and pollution in the ears too.
ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੂਤਕੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸੂਤਕੁ ਪਰੈ ਰਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
Getting up and sitting down, pollution clings to us all the time, and it is in the kitchen as well. ॥2॥
ਫਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਧਿ. ਸਭੁ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ; ਛੂਟਨ ਕੀ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
Everyone knows the way to get caught; hardly anyone knows how to get free.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੈ; ਸੂਤਕੁ. ਤਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੩॥੪੧॥
Says Kabir: those who remember the Lord in their hearts are not touched by this pollution. ॥3॥41॥
Clear up this one doubt for me, Lord,
ਜਉ ਤੁਮ; ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੌ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if You have any use for Your servant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਜਾ ਸਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
Is this mind the stronger, or He in whom the mind finds its rest?
Is the Lord more to be honoured, or the one who has come to know the Lord? ॥1॥
Is Brahma the mightier, or He by whom Brahma was created?
ਬੇਦੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Is the Veda to be revered, or the one from whom its knowledge came? ॥2॥
Says Kabir: this doubt keeps rising in my mind,
ਤੀਰਥੁ ਬਡਾ; ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥੪੨॥
whether the place of pilgrimage is to be worshipped, or the Lord's devotee. ॥3॥42॥
ਦੇਖੌ ਭਾਈ; ਗੵਾਨ ਕੀ ਆਈ ਆਂਧੀ ॥
See, friend, when the storm of knowledge comes,
ਸਭੈ ਉਡਾਨੀ. ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ; ਰਹੈ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਬਾਂਧੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the whole thatch of delusion is blown away; propped up by Maya, it cannot stand. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੁਚਿਤੇ ਕੀ. ਦੁਇ ਥੂਨਿ ਗਿਰਾਨੀ; ਮੋਹ ਬਲੇਡਾ ਟੂਟਾ ॥
The post of duality that held up the wavering mind falls, and the ridge-beam of attachment breaks.
ਤਿਸਨਾ ਛਾਨਿ ਪਰੀ ਧਰ ਊਪਰਿ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਫੂਟਾ ॥੧॥
The thatch of craving comes down to the ground, and the pot of foolish thinking is smashed. ॥1॥
332: ਆਂਧੀ ਪਾਛੇ. ਜੋ ਜਲੁ ਬਰਖੈ; ਤਿਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਨਾਂ ॥
In the rain that falls after the storm, Your devotee is drenched.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਮਨਿ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਉਦੈ ਭਾਨੁ ਜਬ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੪੩॥
Says Kabir: when he sees the sun risen within him, his mind fills with light. ॥2॥43॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥
They neither listen to the Lord's praise nor sing His virtues,
yet with their boastful talk they pull down the sky. ॥1॥
There is no use in giving good advice to such people;
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ. ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਜ; ਤਿਨ ਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਡਰਾਨੇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
from those whom God has kept empty of devotion one should always keep one's distance. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹਿ; ਚੁਰੂ ਭਰਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
They themselves do not give anyone so much as a handful of water,
yet they run down those who have set the Ganges flowing. ॥2॥
Sitting or standing, their ways are always crooked;
lost to themselves, they lead others astray as well. ॥3॥
They know how to do nothing but argue emptily,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਹੂ ਕੋ; ਕਹਿਓ. ਨ ਮਾਨਹਿ ॥੪॥
and do not accept the word of even the most respected of the wise. ॥4॥
Lost to themselves, they make others miss the way too;
they have, as it were, set fire to their own house and gone to sleep inside it. ॥5॥
They are one-eyed themselves, yet they mock others.
Seeing such people, O Kabir, one feels ashamed. ॥6॥1॥44॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੀਵਤ ਪਿਤਰ. ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਕੋਊ; ਮੂਏਂ. ਸਿਰਾਧ ਕਰਾਹੀ ॥
People do not honour their parents while they live, yet feed others in their name once they are dead.
ਪਿਤਰ ਭੀ ਬਪੁਰੇ. ਕਹੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਕਊਆ ਕੂਕਰ ਖਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
How can the poor ancestors receive that food, tell me? Crows and dogs eat it. ॥1॥
Let someone tell me how well-being comes of this.
ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਕਰਤੇ. ਜਗੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The whole world wears itself out in the belief that it brings well-being; how could it? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਾਟੀ ਕੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
People make gods and goddesses of clay and offer living sacrifices before them.
ਐਸੇ ਪਿਤਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਆਪਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
Your ancestors are said to be just the same: they cannot take what they themselves would ask for. ॥2॥
ਸਰਜੀਉ ਕਾਟਹਿ, ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ; ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਕਉ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
People kill the living and worship the lifeless, and so ruin their own hereafter.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ; ਭੈ ਡੂਬੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
They do not know the state that remembering the Lord's Name brings; worldly people are sunk in the fear of custom. ॥3॥
ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਡੋਲਹਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
They worship gods and goddesses and still live in dread, for they do not know the Supreme Lord.
ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਕੁਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਿਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੪੫॥
Says Kabir: they do not remember the Lord who is beyond caste and lineage, and stay entangled in Maya. ॥4॥1॥45॥
ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ. ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ; ਐਸੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
One who keeps turning his mind from evil promptings, and so truly lives, is absorbed in the state where no such promptings arise,
ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਹੀਐ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
so that, living amid Maya, he abides in the Lord who is untouched by Maya, and does not fall into the whirlpool again. ॥1॥
My Lord, only then can the milk be churned,
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਓਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when by the Guru's teaching You keep my mind steady; in this way Your nectar is drunk. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਾਣਿ. ਬਜਰ ਕਲ ਛੇਦੀ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਪਦੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
One who has pierced the hard restlessness of the mind with the Guru's arrow finds the state of light revealed within.
ਸਕਤਿ ਅਧੇਰ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕਾ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਬਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
The mistaking of rope for snake in Maya's darkness is over, and he dwells for ever in the home of the ever-blissful Lord. ॥2॥
ਤਿਨਿ. ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੈ ਧਨਖੁ ਚਢਾਈਐ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
He has, as it were, pierced this world without setting arrow to bow, friend.
333: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬੂਡੀ ਪਵਨੁ ਝੁਲਾਵੈ; ਡੋਰਿ ਰਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
The wind may toss his kite in all ten directions, but the string of his attention stays tied to the Lord. ॥3॥
ਉਨਮਨਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
His mind, reaching the state of longing, is absorbed where no evil promptings arise; double-mindedness and wrong thinking are gone.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਨਭਉ ਇਕੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪੬॥
Says Kabir: he sees a wonder within himself, and his attention is joined to the Lord's Name. ॥4॥2॥46॥
ਉਲਟਤ ਪਵਨ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਖਟੁ ਭੇਦੇ; ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥
As the mind's wandering is turned back, the six chakras are pierced at once, and awareness falls in love with the state where no evil prompting arises.
ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ; ਤਾਸੁ ਖੋਜੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
Detached from Maya, seek Him who neither comes nor goes, neither dies nor is born. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਮਨ ਹੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
O my mind, by turning the mind back from its running one merges in the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਅਕਲਿ ਭਈ ਅਵਰੈ; ਨਾਤਰੁ. ਥਾ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace the understanding is changed; before that one was a stranger to Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਿਵਰੈ ਦੂਰਿ. ਦੂਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਿਵਰੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜੈਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
For one who has understood the Lord as He truly is, what was near moves far off and He who was far is close at hand.
ਅਲਉਤੀ ਕਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਇਆ ਬਰੇਡਾ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
It is like sugar-candy sherbet: only the one who has drunk it knows the taste. ॥2॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਕਥਾ. ਕਾਇ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ; ਐਸਾ ਕੋਇ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ॥
To whom can one speak of You, whose like is nowhere? Rare is anyone so discerning.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਪਲੀਤਾ; ਤਿਨਿ ਤੈਸੀ ਝਲ ਦੇਖੀ ॥੩॥੩॥੪੭॥
Says Kabir: as far as one has lit the fuse of love, so much of the flash has one seen. ॥3॥3॥47॥
ਤਹ ਪਾਵਸ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਧੂਪ ਨਹੀ ਛਹੀਆ; ਤਹ ਉਤਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
In that state no longing remains for the realms of Indra or Vishnu, of sun or moon, of Brahma or Shiva.
ਜੀਵਨ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਦੋਊ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Neither craving for life nor fear of death, neither pain nor pleasure touches one there; no evil thought stirs, and no sense of mine and yours remains. ॥1॥
ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ; ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
The state of poise is like nothing but itself and cannot be described.
ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਚਢੈ, ਜਾਇ ਨ ਮੁਕਾਤੀ; ਹਲੁਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It cannot be weighed or measured against any pleasure, nor called lesser or greater than any. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਰਧ ਉਰਧ ਦੋਊ. ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
There no distinction of low and high remains, nor the sleep of negligence, nor the wandering after Maya.
ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨੁ. ਪਾਵਕੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਹਾ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
No trace is left there of vice, restlessness or craving; the true Guru alone fills the heart. ॥2॥
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲਹੀਐ ॥
Then the Lord, unreachable and beyond the senses, is present within without a break; He is found only by the Guru's grace.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੩॥੪॥੪੮॥
Says Kabir: I offer myself to my Guru; may I stay joined to his holy company. ॥3॥4॥48॥
ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਬੈਲ ਬਿਸਾਹੇ; ਪਵਨੁ ਪੂਜੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਓ ॥
All have bought the two bullocks of sin and virtue, and are born with breath as their capital.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਗੂਣਿ ਭਰੀ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਟਾਂਡ ਬਿਸਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
Each heart carries a sack filled with craving; this is how they have loaded their goods. ॥1॥
Such a merchant-prince is our Lord
that He has sent the whole world out as His traders. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਭਏ ਜਗਾਤੀ; ਮਨ ਤਰੰਗ ਬਟਵਾਰਾ ॥
Lust and anger are the two toll-collectors, and the waves of the mind are the highway robbers.
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ. ਦਾਨੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਹਿ; ਟਾਂਡਾ ਉਤਰਿਓ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Joined with the body of five elements they use up the whole stock, and the load of craving is carried over to the far side. ॥2॥
ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ; ਅਬ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
Says Kabir: listen, O saints, this is how things now stand:
ਘਾਟੀ ਚਢਤ ਬੈਲੁ ਇਕੁ ਥਾਕਾ; ਚਲੋ ਗੋਨਿ ਛਿਟਕਾਈ ॥੩॥੫॥੪੯॥
on the steep climb of remembrance the bullock of sin has tired, thrown off its sack of craving and run away. ॥3॥5॥49॥
ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
There are only a few days in the parents' home; then one must go to the in-laws'.
ਅੰਧਾ ਲੋਕੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਆਣਾ ॥੧॥
The blind, foolish, ignorant world does not know it. ॥1॥
Tell me, why does the bride still stand in her half-length working cloth,
ਪਾਹੂ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ; ਮੁਕਲਾਊ ਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
when the guests who have come to take her away are already in the house? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਓਹ ਜਿ ਦਿਸੈ ਖੂਹੜੀ; ਕਉਨ ਲਾਜੁ ਵਹਾਰੀ ॥
At this pretty well that we see, which woman is letting down her rope?
ਲਾਜੁ ਘੜੀ ਸਿਉ ਤੂਟਿ ਪੜੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਪਨਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
When her rope breaks along with the pitcher, the water-drawer gets up and goes. ॥2॥
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ, ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
If the Master turns kind and shows mercy, He takes her task as His own and sets it right.
334: When she reflects on the Guru's word, then she is known as a wife who has her Husband. ॥3॥
ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ. ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ; ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Think it over and see: everyone wanders bound by past deeds.
ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
What blame is hers? What can the poor thing do? ॥4॥
ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ; ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ. ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
Her hopes unfulfilled, she gets up and leaves; her mind finds no steadiness.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ; ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
Stay attached to the Lord's feet, O Kabir, and keep to His shelter. ॥5॥6॥50॥
ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ. ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
The yogis say: yoga alone is good and sweet, brother, and there is nothing else like it.
ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ; ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
The Jain mendicants, the shaven sannyasis and the Avadhuts all say: we alone have found fulfilment. ॥1॥
Having forgotten the Lord, the blind are lost in delusion;
ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ, ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ; ਤੇ. ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whoever I go to for release from pride is himself bound in its many nooses. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ. ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ; ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
The world stays in that very forgetting of God from which pride is born; that is why it is deluded.
ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ; ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
Pandits, the accomplished, heroes and givers all say: we alone are great. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ. ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Only the one whom the Lord Himself teaches understands; without that understanding life is worthless.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
When the true Guru is met the darkness goes, and in this way the jewel is found. ॥3॥
ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
Give up the stray thoughts of vice to left and right, and hold firmly to the aim of remembering the Lord.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ; ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ. ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
Says Kabir: a mute who has eaten molasses cannot say what it tastes like when asked. ॥4॥7॥51॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
In the mind where there once was the sense of mine there is now none, nor any attachment to the body of five elements.
ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ; ਏ ਅਵਗਨ, ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
As for the practices of Ida, Pingala and Sushmana, brother, who knows where such useless things have gone? ॥1॥
ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ. ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ; ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
The thread of attachment has snapped, its whole expanse within me is gone, and the habit of making distinctions has vanished without trace.
ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ. ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wonder at this comes over me every day, and no one can explain it to me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ; ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
The mind that once held the whole world no longer holds even the body; the mind that wove attachment is itself no more.
ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ; ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
Now the Lord who unites, ever untouched by Maya, dwells there Himself; but this state cannot be told to anyone. ॥2॥
ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
As long as the mind is one with the perishable body, its love is neither joined to the Lord by joining nor broken from Maya by breaking.
ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
Such a mind has no Master and is no one's servant; who then goes to whom? ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ; ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
Says Kabir: my attention stays fixed on Him and rests there day and night.
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ. ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
He alone knows His own mystery, and He is for ever imperishable. ॥4॥1॥52॥
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ, ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ; ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
Fixing my awareness on the Lord and remembering Him are my two earrings; true knowledge of Him is the patched cloak I wear.
ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ; ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ. ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
I sit in the cave of the thought-free state; giving up worldly imaginings is my path. ॥1॥
My King, I am a yogi in love with You,
so death, sorrow and separation do not touch me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
Telling of the Lord's presence through all regions and universes is my horn; knowing the whole world to be perishable is my ash-bag.
ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ; ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
Turning back the pull of three-stranded Maya is my trance; so I am free even as a householder. ॥2॥
ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ; ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
Mind and breath are the two gourds of my lute, and the ever-abiding Lord is the neck I have fitted to it.
335: ਥਿਰੁ ਭਈ ਤੰਤੀ. ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਅਨਹਦ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੀ ॥੩॥
The string of my awareness has grown firm and never breaks; the kinguri plays on without pause. ॥3॥
ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ. ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੇ; ਮਾਇਆ ਡੋਲ. ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Hearing it, my mind is so wholly absorbed that no shove from Maya can touch it.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨਹੀ; ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੩॥
Says Kabir: the devoted yogi who plays such a game and departs is never born again. ॥4॥2॥53॥
ਗਜ ਨਵ. ਗਜ ਦਸ. ਗਜ ਇਕੀਸ; ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਤਨਾਈ ॥
One whole warp is stretched: nine yards of sockets, ten of senses, and twenty-one more.
ਸਾਠ ਸੂਤ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਬਹਤਰਿ; ਪਾਟੁ ਲਗੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥
Sixty veins are its lengthwise threads, the nine joints its nine pieces, and seventy-two small veins the extra weft added to it. ॥1॥
Desire sets out to have this warp woven
when the weaver, the soul, leaves its home and forgets the Lord's feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਜੀ. ਨ ਮਿਨੀਐ; ਤੋਲਿ. ਨ ਤੁਲੀਐ; ਪਾਚਨੁ ਸੇਰ ਅਢਾਈ ॥
This warp is not measured in yards nor weighed with weights, yet it needs its two and a half seers of sizing each day.
ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਚਨੁ. ਬੇਗਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਝਗਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਘਰਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
If it does not get that sizing on time, it raises a quarrel inside the house itself. ॥2॥
ਦਿਨ ਕੀ ਬੈਠ. ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਸ; ਇਹ ਬੇਲਾ ਕਤ ਆਈ ॥
For a few days of living the soul turns rebel against its Master, and this chance does not come to hand again.
ਛੂਟੇ ਕੂੰਡੇ. ਭੀਗੈ ਪੁਰੀਆ; ਚਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਰੀਸਾਈ ॥੩॥
In the end these things are taken away while the mind's desires stay caught in them, and the weaver leaves in vexation. ॥3॥
ਛੋਛੀ ਨਲੀ. ਤੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਿਕਸੈ; ਨਤਰ ਰਹੀ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥
The bobbin runs empty, no thread comes out, and the beam holds no more cloth.
ਛੋਡਿ ਪਸਾਰੁ. ਈਹਾ ਰਹੁ ਬਪੁਰੀ; ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੪॥
Says Kabir: wretched desire, give up this tangle and now set this soul free. ॥4॥3॥54॥
ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ. ਏਕਾ ਮਿਲੀ; ਕਿੰਬਾ ਹੋਇ, ਮਹੋਇ ॥
When a person's awareness joins the one Light and becomes one with it, no pride at all remains within.
ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਊਪਜੈ; ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
Only that person suffers from pride in whose heart the Name does not arise. ॥1॥
O my dark and beautiful Lord,
my mind is joined to Your feet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਿ ਏਹੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਿ ਭੋਗੁ ॥
This attainment is found on meeting the Guru; beside it, what is yoga and what is enjoyment?
ਦੁਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
When the two meet, the Guru's Word and the disciple's awareness, the outcome is union with the Lord's Name. ॥2॥
ਲੋਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਇਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਹੈ; ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
The world takes the Guru's Word for a mere song, but it is reflection on the qualities of God,
ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹੋਇ; ਮਾਨਸ ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ॥੩॥
like the teaching a man is thought to receive at Kashi in the hour of death. ॥3॥
ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
Whoever sings or listens to the Lord's Name with love,
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਨਹੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥੫੫॥
says Kabir: there is no doubt he reaches the highest spiritual state. ॥4॥1॥4॥55॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਤ. ਤੇ ਡੂਬੇ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
All who make such efforts drown; these rites do not carry anyone across the world-ocean.
ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮ; ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
Through performing rites, caste duties and many religious vows, pride burns up the mind. ॥1॥
ਸਾਸ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਤੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
The Lord alone gives life and livelihood; why have you put Him out of your mind?
ਹੀਰਾ ਲਾਲੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This birth is a diamond, a priceless ruby, yet you have lost it for the sake of a cowrie. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾ ਭੂਖ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਲਾਗੀ; ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਨਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
You have never considered in your heart that, through wandering, the thirst and hunger of Maya have taken hold of you.
ਉਨਮਤ ਮਾਨ ਹਿਰਿਓ, ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਨ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
You stay intoxicated and proud, and have never settled the Guru's Word in your mind. ॥2॥
ਸੁਆਦ ਲੁਭਤ. ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ; ਮਦ ਰਸ ਲੈਤ ਬਿਕਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
You are greedy for tastes; driven by the craving of the senses, you keep relishing the drunkenness of vice.
ਕਰਮ ਭਾਗ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੰਗਾਨੇ; ਕਾਸਟ. ਲੋਹ ਉਧਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
Those whose good fortune awakens He brings into the company of the holy and saves, as wood carries iron across. ॥3॥
ਧਾਵਤ ਜੋਨਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਅਬ ਦੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਮ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥
I am worn out with running and wandering through births and forms of life; having borne pain upon pain, I have given up every other support.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਿਓ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥੫੬॥
Says Kabir: on meeting the Guru the highest relish arises, and loving devotion carries one across. ॥4॥1॥5॥56॥
ਕਾਲਬੂਤ ਕੀ ਹਸਤਨੀ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਿਓ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
O foolish mind, the Lord has set up this world as a play, like the dummy she-elephant made to trap an elephant.
ਕਾਮ ਸੁਆਇ. ਗਜ ਬਸਿ ਪਰੇ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਸੀਸ ॥੧॥
Through lust the elephant is caught, O foolish mind, and then bears the goad upon its head. ॥1॥
336: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਚੁ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਚੁ; ਸਮਝੁ ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ ॥
O foolish mind, have sense: keep clear of sensual pleasures and stay joined to the Lord.
ਨਿਰਭੈ ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ; ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ, ਗਹਿਓ ਨ. ਰਾਮ ਜਹਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Why do you not drop your dread and remember the Lord, O foolish mind, and why do you not take His support? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮਰਕਟ ਮੁਸਟੀ ਅਨਾਜ ਕੀ. ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਲੀਨੀ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
The monkey stretched out its hand, O foolish mind, and took a fistful of grain,
ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਪਰਿਆ. ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਨਾਚਿਓ ਘਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
then fell into dread over how to get free, and now it dances at the door of every house. ॥2॥
ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ. ਸੂਅਟਾ ਗਹਿਓ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਮਾਯਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
As the parrot is caught on the tube trap, O foolish mind, so does Maya deal with the world.
ਜੈਸਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਾ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਤਿਉ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਸਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
Like the colour of safflower, O foolish mind, this spread-out world lasts only a few days. ॥3॥
ਨਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਤੀਰਥ ਘਨੇ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਪੂਜਨ ਕਉ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਵ ॥
There are plenty of holy places to bathe at, O foolish mind, and plenty of gods to worship,
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਛੂਟਨੁ ਨਹੀ, ਮਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰੇ; ਛੂਟਨੁ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੫੭॥
but, says Kabir, that brings no release; release comes only through remembering the Lord. ॥4॥1॥6॥57॥
ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਦਹੈ, ਪਵਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਗਨੈ; ਤਸਕਰੁ. ਨੇਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Fire cannot burn this wealth, wind cannot blow it away, and no thief can come near it.
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ, ਕਰਿ ਸੰਚਉਨੀ; ਸੋ ਧਨੁ. ਕਤ ਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; that wealth is never lost. ॥1॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਧਨੁ. ਮਾਧਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਧਰਣੀਧਰੁ; ਇਹੈ ਸਾਰ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
My wealth is the Lord, Madho, Gobind, support of the whole earth; this is called the finest wealth of all.
ਜੋ ਸੁਖੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ. ਰਾਜਿ ਨ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The joy found in worshipping the Lord Gobind is not to be had even in kingship. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ. ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿਕ; ਖੋਜਤ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
For the sake of this wealth Shiva, Sanak and the rest searched and turned away from the world.
ਮਨਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੁ. ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ; ਪਰੈ ਨ. ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
One in whose mind the Giver of liberation dwells, and on whose tongue is the Lord, is not caught in Death's noose. ॥2॥
ਨਿਜ ਧਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ, ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ; ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
Devotion and knowledge of God are one's very own wealth; the wise one to whom the Guru gives it has a mind that rests in Him.
ਜਲਤ ਅੰਭ, ਥੰਭਿ ਮਨੁ ਧਾਵਤ; ਭਰਮ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
It is water for one who is burning and a prop for the wandering mind; the fear of doubt's bonds flees. ॥3॥
ਕਹੈ ਕਬੀਰੁ. ਮਦਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
Says Kabir: you who are drunk with lust, think it over in your heart and see,
ਤੁਮ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਸ੍ਵ ਹਸਤੀ; ਹਮ ਘਰਿ. ਏਕੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੫੮॥
if your house holds hundreds of thousands and millions of horses and elephants, mine holds the one Lord. ॥4॥1॥7॥58॥
ਜਿਉ ਕਪਿ ਕੇ ਕਰ. ਮੁਸਟਿ ਚਨਨ ਕੀ; ਲੁਬਧਿ. ਨ ਤਿਆਗੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
As a monkey got a fistful of chickpeas in its hand and, out of greed, would not let go,
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਏ. ਲਾਲਚ ਸਿਉ; ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ. ਗਰਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ॥੧॥
so every deed a person does out of greed falls back around his own neck. ॥1॥
Without devotion a human life passes in vain.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਸਚੁ ਰਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without worship of God in the company of the holy, the ever-abiding Lord does not stay in any heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਉਦਿਆਨ. ਕੁਸਮ ਪਰਫੁਲਿਤ; ਕਿਨਹਿ. ਨ ਘ੍ਰਾਉ ਲਇਓ ॥
As flowers bloom in the wilderness and no one takes in their scent,
ਤੈਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲ ਹਇਓ ॥੨॥
so beings wander through countless forms of life and fall to Death again and again. ॥2॥
ਇਆ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਤ ਦਾਰਾ; ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
This wealth, youth, sons and wife He gave only to be looked upon,
ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਅਟਕਿ. ਜੋ ਉਰਝੇ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿ ਲਇਓ ॥੩॥
yet people stop there and get entangled in them, and the senses pull them away. ॥3॥
ਅਉਧ ਅਨਲ. ਤਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ; ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਠਾਟੁ ਠਇਓ ॥
The body is a hut of straw and the passing years are the fire upon it; on every side the same arrangement stands.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰਨ ਕਉ; ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਓਟ ਲਇਓ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥੫੯॥
Says Kabir: to cross this dreadful world-ocean I have taken the Guru's support. ॥4॥1॥8॥59॥
From the father's unclean drop and the mother's blood
God has put together this puppet of clay. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਛੁ ਆਹਿ ਨ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
O Lord, I have no existence apart from You, and nothing belongs to me.
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਰਸੁ; ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Body, wealth and life itself are all Your gifts, O Gobind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Into this clay the breath has been set to hold it up,
337: yet the soul sets going a false and sprawling show. ॥2॥
Those who have piled up property worth five hundred thousand
find that at the last moment their pitcher, the body, is smashed as well. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: the very foundation raised for you,
O proud one, will be destroyed in an instant. ॥4॥1॥9॥60॥
O my soul, pray that you may remember the Lord with the same love and faith
with which Dhru and Prahlad remembered Him. ॥1॥
O Lord, merciful to the lowly, trusting in Your kindness
I have put my whole family aboard Your ship. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਵੈ ॥
When it pleases Him, He makes this family obey His command
and so takes the whole boatload safely across. ॥2॥
One in whom such understanding appears by the Guru's grace
has done with being born and dying again and again. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: remember the Lord, the Bearer of the bow,
and know Him as the only One everywhere, in this world and the next. ॥4॥2॥10॥61॥
ਜੋਨਿ ਛਾਡਿ; ਜਉ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
When the soul leaves the womb and comes into the world,
the wind of Maya touches it and at once it forgets its Master. ॥1॥
ਜੀਅਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨਾ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my soul, sing the Lord's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਉਰਧ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
While it hangs head down in the womb, absorbed in devotion to God,
it stays unharmed even in the fire of the belly. ॥2॥
It arrives here after wandering through eight million four hundred thousand forms of life,
ਅਬ ਕੇ ਛੁਟਕੇ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਠਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
but if it misses this chance too, it finds no place of rest anywhere. ॥3॥
Says Kabir: tell your soul to remember the Lord, the Bearer of the bow,
who is neither seen being born nor known to die. ॥4॥1॥11॥62॥
ਸੁਰਗ ਬਾਸੁ. ਨ ਬਾਛੀਐ; ਡਰੀਐ ਨ. ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
Do not long for a home in heaven, and do not live in fear of being lodged in hell.
ਹੋਨਾ ਹੈ. ਸੋ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ; ਮਨਹਿ. ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
Whatever is to happen will happen, so do not build up hopes in the mind. ॥1॥
Sing the praises of the Lord,
ਜਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for by this the highest treasure is found. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਪੁ ਕਿਆ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ; ਕਿਆ ਬਰਤੁ ਕਿਆ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
Of what use are chanting, penance, self-restraint, fasting or ritual bathing
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ. ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥
so long as one has not grasped the way of loving and worshipping God? ॥2॥
ਸੰਪੈ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਹਰਖੀਐ; ਬਿਪਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥
Do not swell with joy at the sight of prosperity, nor grieve at the sight of hardship.
ਜਿਉ ਸੰਪੈ. ਤਿਉ ਬਿਪਤਿ ਹੈ; ਬਿਧ ਨੇ ਰਚਿਆ. ਸੋ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
As prosperity comes from Him, so does hardship; what God ordains is what happens. ॥3॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਸੰਤਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
Says Kabir: now I understand that God lives in the hearts of the saints.
ਸੇਵਕ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਹ ਘਟ ਬਸੈ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥੬੩॥
Those servants are graceful in their service in whose hearts the Lord dwells. ॥4॥1॥12॥63॥
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਤੇਰੋ ਕੋਇ ਨਹੀ; ਖਿੰਚਿ ਲੇਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
O my mind, no one will be yours in the end, so do not haul other people's load on to your own head.
ਬਿਰਖ ਬਸੇਰੋ ਪੰਖਿ ਕੋ; ਤੈਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
As birds perch on a tree for the night, such is the stay in this world. ॥1॥
Those who follow the Guru drink the relish of the Lord's Name,
ਜਿਹ ਰਸ; ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਰਸ ਅਉਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and through that relish every other relish is forgotten. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਉਰ ਮੁਏ. ਕਿਆ ਰੋਈਐ; ਜਉ ਆਪਾ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਇ ॥
Why weep when someone else dies, when our own self will not remain for ever?
ਜੋ ਉਪਜੈ. ਸੋ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਹੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਕਰਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
Whatever is born perishes, so weeping in grief is pointless. ॥2॥
ਜਹ ਕੀ ਉਪਜੀ. ਤਹ ਰਚੀ; ਪੀਵਤ. ਮਰਦਨ ਲਾਗ ॥
As they drink it in the company of the Guru's people, their soul stays joined to the One from whom it arose.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਚਿਤਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ; ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੩॥੬੪॥
Says Kabir: those who call the Lord to mind and remember Him grow detached from the world. ॥3॥2॥13॥64॥
ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਾਮਨੀ; ਲੋਚਨ ਭਰੀ. ਲੇ ਉਸਾਸਾ ॥
A wife watches the road, her eyes full of tears and her breath coming in sighs;
338: ਉਰ. ਨ ਭੀਜੈ, ਪਗੁ. ਨਾ ਖਿਸੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
her heart is never satisfied and her foot never shifts; so it is with the soul that waits for sight of the Lord. ॥1॥
Fly, black crow, I beg you, fly,
ਬੇਗਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so that I may soon meet my beloved Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
Says Kabir: to reach life's real state, give yourself to devotion to the Lord.
ਏਕੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ; ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੪॥੬੫॥
Let the Lord's Name be your one support, and remember Him with your tongue. ॥2॥1॥14॥65॥
ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਘਨ ਤੁਰਸੀ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਵਾ; ਮਾਝ ਬਨਾ ਰਸਿ ਗਾਊਂ ਰੇ ॥
He stood with thick tulsi bushes all around, singing with love in the midst of that grove;
ਉਆ ਕਾ ਸਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਗੁਆਰਨਿ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਹੂ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
seeing his form the milkmaid was captivated and said: do not leave me to come and go anywhere else. ॥1॥
O Bearer of the bow, my mind is fastened to Your feet in the same way,
but only one of great good fortune meets You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿੰਦ੍ਰਾਬਨ. ਮਨ ਹਰਨ ਮਨੋਹਰ; ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਰੇ ॥
In Brindaban Krishna grazed the cows and stole and charmed every mind;
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਸਾਰਿੰਗਧਰ; ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਨਾਊ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੫॥੬੬॥
and the one whose Master You are, O Bearer of the bow, goes by the name Kabir. ॥2॥2॥15॥66॥
ਬਿਪਲ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕੇਤੇ ਹੈ ਪਹਿਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਬਨ ਮਧੇ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
Many put on long, flowing robes, and what of it? What is gained by going to live in the forest?
ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਨਰ ਦੇਵਾ ਧੋਖੇ; ਕਿਆ ਜਲਿ ਬੋਰਿਓ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
What comes of worshipping the gods with smouldering incense, and what of deliberately plunging the body in water? ॥1॥
I can see, O soul, that you too are throwing yourself away.
Seek out the one Lord, you ignorant one.
ਜਤ ਜਤ ਦੇਖਉ. ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਉ; ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wherever I look, I never see it the same way twice, this Maya you are wrapped up in. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗਿਆਨੀ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਬਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੀ; ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
One debates knowledge, one sits in meditation, one preaches to others, yet this whole world is caught in Maya's tangle.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਇਕ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ; ਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੬॥੬੭॥
Says Kabir: without remembering the one Name of the Lord, this world lies blinded by Maya. ॥2॥1॥16॥67॥
ਮਨ ਰੇ. ਛਾਡਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ; ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਚਹੁ. ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਡਾਂਡੇ ॥
O mind, stop chasing about; step out boldly and dance, for these are only Maya's swindles.
ਸੂਰੁ ਕਿ. ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪੈ; ਸਤੀ ਕਿ. ਸਾਂਚੈ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥੧॥
What sort of hero fears the battlefield in front of him? No woman is a sati who starts gathering up her pots. ॥1॥
Give up wavering, O foolish mind.
ਅਬ ਤਉ ਜਰੇ ਮਰੇ. ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਲੀਨੋ ਹਾਥਿ ਸੰਧਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
She who has taken the vermilion-smeared coconut in her hand reaches her goal now only by burning to death. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲੀਨੇ; ਇਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਗੂਤਾ ॥
Lust cheats one, anger another, Maya a third; this is how the whole world is being ruined.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਸਗਲ ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੭॥੬੮॥
Kabir prays: may I never let go of the Lord King, who is higher than the highest. ॥2॥2॥17॥68॥
ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਿਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਨ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
Your order rests upon my head, and I raise no objection to it.
ਤੁਹੀ ਦਰੀਆ. ਤੁਹੀ ਕਰੀਆ; ਤੁਝੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਸਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
You are the ocean and You are the boatman; only through You do I get across. ॥1॥
O man, take up devotion to God,
ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਰੋਸੁ ਧਰਉ ਕਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whether the Master shows you anger or love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਜਿਉ ਫੂਲੁ ਜਈ ਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
Your Name is my support, as water is to the flower that blooms in it.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ; ਜੀਆਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੬੯॥
Says Kabir: I am a servant of Your household; keep me alive or put me to death, as You wish. ॥2॥18॥69॥
ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੀਅ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਨੰਦੁ ਬਹੁ ਥਾਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
You say that when Nand was worn out from wandering through eight million four hundred thousand forms of life,
ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਲੀਓ ਹੈ; ਭਾਗੁ ਬਡੋ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
God, pleased with his devotion, took birth in his house, and great was that poor man's fortune. ॥1॥
ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁ ਕਹਤ ਹਉ ਨੰਦ ਕੋ ਨੰਦਨੁ; ਨੰਦ ਸੁ ਨੰਦਨੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
You who say that God became the son of Nand, tell me whose son Nand himself was.
ਧਰਨਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਬ ਇਹੁ ਨੰਦੁ ਕਹਾ ਥੋ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When there was neither earth nor sky nor the ten directions, where was this Nand then? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
339: ਸੰਕਟਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਰੈ. ਜੋਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਰੇ ॥
He whose name is the Untainted One does not fall into suffering and does not enter the womb.
ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ. ਐਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ. ਮਾਈ ਨ ਬਾਪੋ ਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੭੦॥
Kabir's Master is a Lord who has neither mother nor father. ॥2॥19॥70॥
ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਨਿੰਦਉ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਲੋਗੁ ਨਿੰਦਉ ॥
Let the world slander me, by all means let it decry my faults;
the Lord's servant is glad to hear himself slandered,
for slander is his father and slander is his mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only when people expose our faults can we go to heaven,
and settle the wealth of the Name in the mind.
If we are slandered while the heart is pure,
the slanderer is helping to wash our mind clean. ॥1॥
Whoever decries us is our friend,
for our attention stays fixed on our slanderer.
Our real ill-wisher is the one who stops our faults from being exposed;
the slanderer in fact wants our life to become good. ॥2॥
The more we are slandered, the more love for God grows within us,
because slander rescues us from our faults.
So for the servant Kabir, having his faults made public is the best thing there is.
The slanderer drowns, while we get safely across. ॥3॥20॥71॥
ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ. ਤੂੰ ਐਸਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ; ਤਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ, ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord King, able to carry all across, You fear no one; Your way is unlike any other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ, ਤਬ ਤੁਮ ਨਾਹੀ; ਅਬ ਤੁਮ ਹਹੁ, ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
So long as we count ourselves as something, You do not show Yourself within us; now that You dwell here, that pride of ours is gone.
ਅਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ, ਏਕ ਭਏ ਹਹਿ; ਏਕੈ ਦੇਖਤ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਹੀ ॥੧॥
Now You and we have become one, and on seeing You the mind is convinced. ॥1॥
ਜਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੋਤੀ. ਤਬ ਬਲੁ ਕੈਸਾ; ਅਬ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਲੁ ਨ ਖਟਾਈ ॥
So long as we trust our own cleverness we have no spiritual strength; now cleverness and strength are nothing we take pride in.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਬੁਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਈ ਮੇਰੀ; ਬੁਧਿ ਬਦਲੀ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੭੨॥
Says Kabir: You have taken away my cleverness; my understanding has changed and the goal is attained. ॥2॥21॥72॥
ਖਟ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ; ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਬੀਚ ਪਾਈ ॥
Having made six chakras, He built this little chamber and set a matchless thing inside it;
ਕੁੰਜੀ ਕੁਲਫੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਕਰਤੇ. ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
He made the breath its lock and key, and the Creator took no time over it. ॥1॥
ਅਬ ਮਨ ਜਾਗਤ ਰਹੁ; ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
ਗਾਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ; ਚੋਰੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਘਰੁ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through carelessness you have wasted your life; the thief goes in and robs the house of the heedless. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੰਚ ਪਹਰੂਆ. ਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਰਾ ॥
The five watchmen who stay at its doors are not to be trusted.
ਚੇਤਿ ਸੁਚੇਤ. ਚਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ; ਤਉ ਲੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਉਜਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
Stay alert and keep the Master in mind, and the light within you will shine out. ॥2॥
ਨਉ ਘਰ ਦੇਖਿ. ਜੁ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਭੂਲੀ; ਬਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
The soul-bride who goes astray at the sight of the nine houses does not find that matchless thing.
ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਨਵੈ ਘਰ ਮੂਸੇ; ਦਸਵੈਂ ਤਤੁ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥੨੨॥੭੩॥
Says Kabir: when all nine houses are brought under control, God's light settles in the tenth. ॥3॥22॥73॥
ਮਾਈ. ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਓ; ਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
O mother, I have known no one else as my support,
ਸਿਵ ਸਨਕਾਦਿ. ਜਾਸੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਤਾਸੁ ਬਸਹਿ ਮੋਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for my life dwells in the One whose praises Shiva, Sanak and the rest sing. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਿਰਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੰਮਿਤ; ਗਗਨ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
Since the Guru gave me higher understanding, my heart has been lit up and my attention stays fixed on high.
ਬਿਖੈ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਭਾਗੇ; ਮਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
The chains of sensual disease and dread have snapped, and my mind has found peace within its own home. ॥1॥
ਏਕ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਰਤਿ. ਜਾਨਿ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਦੂਸਰ ਮਨਹਿ. ਨ ਆਨਾਨਾ ॥
My understanding loves the one God alone; knowing Him and trusting Him, I bring no other into my mind.
ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ; ਤਿਆਗਿ ਘਟਿਓ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
Having given up the mind's desires, I am filled with the scent of sandalwood, and pride has faded away. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਗਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਜਸੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਤਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹੈ ਥਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥
In one who sings the Master's praise and meditates on Him, God makes His home.
ਤਿਹ ਬਡ ਭਾਗ ਬਸਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ; ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਮਥਾਨਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
Great is the fortune of one in whose mind He dwells; a high destiny shows upon that forehead. ॥3॥
ਕਾਟਿ ਸਕਤਿ. ਸਿਵ ਸਹਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਓ; ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾਨਾ ॥
When Maya's hold is cut and the divine light shines forth, the mind stays absorbed in the One alone.
340: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ; ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾਨਾਂ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੭੪॥
Says Kabir: on meeting the Guru the highest peace is gained, wandering ends and the mind settles in God. ॥4॥23॥74॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਬਾਵਨ ਅਖਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
Gauri Purbi · Bavan Akhri · Bhagat Kabir
ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth, the Maker — realised by the Guru's grace
ਬਾਵਨ ਅਛਰ ਲੋਕ ਤ੍ਰੈ; ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਇਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
The fifty-two letters are in use throughout the world, and all its dealings run through them.
ਏ ਅਖਰ ਖਿਰਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ; ਓਇ ਅਖਰ ਇਨ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
But these letters will perish; no letters among them can describe union with the Timeless One. ॥1॥
Letters are used only where a thing can be told;
ਜਹ ਅਬੋਲ; ਤਹ ਮਨੁ. ਨ ਰਹਾਵਾ ॥
in the state beyond telling, the mind that would tell does not itself remain.
In what can be told and in what cannot, it is God Himself,
ਜਸ ਓਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤਸ ਲਖੈ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
and no one can describe Him exactly as He is. ॥2॥
ਅਲਹ ਲਹਉ. ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ; ਕਹਉ. ਤ ਕੋ ਉਪਕਾਰ ॥
Even if I find the Unfindable I cannot describe Him, and if I say something it benefits no one.
ਬਟਕ ਬੀਜ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਤੀਨਿ ਲੋਕ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥੩॥
He whose expanse the three worlds are pervades them as the banyan is in its seed. ॥3॥
ਅਲਹ ਲਹੰਤਾ ਭੇਦ ਛੈ; ਕਛੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਭੇਦ ॥
In striving to meet God my sense of twoness has gone, and I have understood a little of His secret.
ਉਲਟਿ ਭੇਦ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਓ; ਪਾਇਓ ਅਭੰਗ ਅਛੇਦ ॥੪॥
With that twoness overturned, my mind is pierced through by God and I have found the imperishable, unpierceable Lord. ॥4॥
ਤੁਰਕ. ਤਰੀਕਤਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ; ਹਿੰਦੂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ॥
So a good Muslim is known as one who follows the Sufi path, and a good Hindu as one who searches the Vedas and Puranas.
ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਨ ਕਾਰਨੇ; ਕਛੂਅਕ ਪੜੀਐ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੫॥
To give the mind an understanding of the higher life, one must read at least some words of wisdom. ॥5॥
The all-pervading God who makes everything I know to be imperishable;
ਲਿਖਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੇਟੈ; ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
any being He creates and then wipes away I do not accept as His equal.
If someone comes to know that all-pervading God within,
then, knowing Him, that person's high awareness is never destroyed. ॥6॥
If I can settle the ray (of the sun of wisdom) in the lotus of the heart,
then the moonlight (of Maya) cannot make that opened flower close again.
ਅਰੁ ਜੇ ਤਹਾ; ਕੁਸਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
And if in that flowering I can also enjoy the bliss of the blossom,
it is beyond telling; what could I say to make it understood? ॥7॥
When this bird of a mind comes to rest in the hollow of its own true self, at God's feet,
ਖੋੜੇ ਛਾਡਿ; ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
it does not leave that nest to fly off in the ten directions.
Coming to know its Husband, it stays settled in the Lord, the source of forgiveness,
ਤਉ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਖਿਅਉ; ਅਖੈ ਪਦੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੮॥
and then, one with the Imperishable, it gains a standing that never perishes. ॥8॥
One who has come to know God through the Guru's word
is drawn by no other talk.
He stays unattached like a bird and wanders nowhere;
he holds in his heart the Lord whom Maya cannot seize, and so keeps his awareness fixed at God's feet. ॥9॥
In every body it is that Lord who dwells.
ਘਟ ਫੂਟੇ; ਘਟਿ. ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
When a body breaks like a pitcher, God is never made any less.
ਤਾ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ; ਘਾਟ ਜਉ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
When someone finds the landing place within this very body,
ਸੋ ਘਟੁ ਛਾਡਿ; ਅਵਘਟ ਕਤ ਧਾਵਾ ॥੧੦॥
he does not leave that landing to go stumbling among ravines. ॥10॥
ਙੰਙਾ. ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ; ਨਿਰਵਾਰੋ ਸੰਦੇਹ ॥
Restrain your senses well, build love for God and clear away your want of faith.
ਨਾਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ. ਨ ਭਾਜੀਐ; ਪਰਮ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਏਹ ॥੧੧॥
Do not run from the task thinking it cannot be done; this is the highest wisdom. ॥11॥
This world that God has made is one vast picture.
Let go of attachment to the picture and keep the Painter in mind,
for the trouble is just this, that the picture captivates the mind.
So leave the picture and keep your heart threaded to the Painter. ॥12॥
With this Painter, who is King of all,
ਛਕਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਰਹਹੁ; ਛਾਡਿ ਕਿ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
why do you not stay, giving up other hopes and standing firm?
ਰੇ ਮਨ. ਮੈ ਤਉ; ਛਿਨ ਛਿਨ ਸਮਝਾਵਾ ॥
O mind, I tell you at every moment:
where are you binding yourself, forgetting Him? ॥13॥
When someone, while still living amid Maya, burns away the body's cravings,
that person, having burnt the pride of youth, learns the right way to live.
ਅਸ ਜਰਿ ਪਰ ਜਰਿ; ਜਰਿ ਜਬ ਰਹੈ ॥
When a person burns away pride in his own wealth and hope of another's, and lives within his means,
then, reaching a high spiritual state, he gains the radiance of God's light. ॥14॥
